newsitem.title: UK: Results still awaited in Libya sugar buying tender.
newsitem.headline: Results still awaited in Libya sugar buying tender.

text.p: The result of Libya's recent tender to buy white sugar is not expected to emerge much before the weekend, European brokers said on Wednesday.
Earlier this week, Libya was reported to be in the market to buy at least one cargo of quality 45 ICUMSA sugar, most likely for nearby or May shipment.
Traders said Libya could take more than one cargo if suppliers offered attractive prices.
But Libya could still postpone its tender and would be unlikely to take any decision quickly, they said.
